meaning: Integer identifier for one independent simulated sequence; group by this field for train/test splitting. Not a predictor.
Simulated step index 0–99 within each sequence; no real timestamp. Not a predictor.
Synthetic oil pressure in kilopascals (kPa). Normal values are mapped to an RPM-dependent assumed envelope; fault sequences use Toyota Prius c manual reference test points.
Engine speed in revolutions per minute (RPM).
Vehicle speed in source dataset units, interpreted as km/h for the OBD-II source.
Sequence-level simulated scenario: normal, overheating, or low_oil_pressure. Not a predictor; can leak labels.
Row-level target: normal before fault onset, then overheating or low_oil_pressure after onset.
Severity target: normal, warning, or critical. Thresholds and warning margins are documented in methodology.
Binary onset/state indicator derived from fault_type; not a predictor because it directly leaks the target.
